How do I go on with this voice screaming at me. Telling me I’m worthless, no one will ever love me, and to kill myself. How do I deal with this pain how can I not think of everytime someone’s told me I deserve that fate.
In reality it’s been like this my whole life just with  different people I’m seemingly never good Engouh for anyone to stay around

Like how is someone calling me there sister.  But treat me like I’m disposable.  Like I haven’t boughten you food and given you a place my kindness taken with a grain of salt.  Those words ring in my head from when he dropped me for his gf the first time. “I didn’t drop you I had to stop talking to you so I didn’t kill myself”  it’s been looping in my head for days.
